metadata.description: Advanced Claude Code plugins for enforced dev workflows and best practices.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Enforced dev workflow (/dev + /spec + /prd) with dual-model review, independent evaluator architecture, AC-driven MODULE progress, aligned §N.M section numbering, ADR (Architecture Decision Records) system, upstream-alignment escape hatches, worktree-parallel /dev, read-only `/dev board` snapshot dashboard, a system-acceptance witness layer, and template-version drift visibility. Includes `dev`, `spec`, `prd` skills plus opt-in statusline. Latest: 3.4.0 the Iron Rule (no-escape-hatch) now explicitly distinguishes softening a live evaluator finding (forbidden) from declaring a tool/scope boundary (required), and every completion summary (/dev SUMMARY, /spec Final Report + UT.9, /prd HANDOFF) carries a structured, mechanically-sourced 'Scope & unverified' field. Earlier: 3.1.0 atomic, independently-adjudicable SYS-AC criteria (§1.1), 3.2.0 system-acceptance harness + executability (declare/run the wired e2e + explicit user-accepted deferral), 3.3.0 `/spec upgrade-template` renumber-preserve on a mid-template section insert.

plugins.name: claude-best-practice
plugins.description: Claude Code best practices: explore-plan-code discipline, verification-first development, context management, prompt scoping, and session strategy.

plugins.name: code-companion
plugins.description: macOS Dynamic Island for code agents. Floating status pill shows pending approvals and active sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI. Click to jump to terminal.

plugins.name: telegram-channels-pro
plugins.description: Telegram-channels-pro daemon: single-instance Telegram bot daemon + Unix-socket MCP transport for claude sessions, sliding-window quarantine reliability (RC#1 fix), watchdog (orphan/stuck/idle), first-run admin registration window, structured JSON logs with redaction. v0.1 infrastructure slice — daemon-core + telegram-client + mcp-server-proxy (daemon side) + admin-auth + observability. M004 mcp-tools, M005 routing, M007 deployment ship in a subsequent release.
